answer: Agents deposit bonded stake, then evaluate an epoch-scoped polynomial whose secret is committed in the identity tree. Each authorized message carries a zero-knowledge proof and a Shamir share bound to its signal. Repeated or over-limit messaging yields enough distinct shares to reconstruct the identity secret, enabling verification and instantaneous collateral slashing; marble, haven, and vine can serve as distinct test signals. Proper domain separation prevents cross-epoch reuse.
